memories.subject: cdhdr
memories.fact: the change-document header extract is a FILTERED SUBSET. It carries 57 object classes; cdhdr_history carries 72. Missing from cdhdr: PBC, SETS, SUSR_PROF and every custom Y* class.
memories.implication: NEVER answer 'who changed this' from cdhdr alone. Read cdhdr_history too and reconcile. An object absent from cdhdr has not necessarily stopped changing — it may simply not be in this extract.

memories.subject: cdhdr_history
memories.fact: the fuller change log: 72 object classes, 2024-01-01 to 2026-06-20, and the ONLY store carrying PBC, SETS (hierarchy maintenance), SUSR_PROF (authorisation profiles) and the custom Y* change-document objects.
memories.implication: this is the default change instrument, not the fallback. Hierarchy and authorisation questions can ONLY be answered here.

memories.subject: FMFINCODE

memories.implication: who creates and changes funds cannot be answered from the change log at all. Fall back to A8 attribution against the execution log — it is the only instrument left for the most heavily populated master in the model.

memories.subject: HR features
memories.fact: every HR feature is COMPILED into a generated program named /1PAPA/FEAT<client><NAME>, and that program is readable through RPY_PROGRAM_READ. T549D gives the name and the structure
memories.implication: a decision tree maintained in PE03 is NOT invisible. When a gate cannot be found in code or tables, look for a feature and read its compiled program

memories.subject: payroll calculation layer
memories.fact: schemas (T52C0/T52C1), rules (T52C5), wage types (T512T) and features (T549D) are ALL readable from P01 over RFC. 68,767 schema steps, 166,453 rule lines, 60,078 wage types, 2,888 features
memories.implication: payroll logic is not a black box. When a calculation cannot be found in ABAP, it is probably in the payroll engine — and the engine is configuration, which reads like data

memories.subject: payroll end to end
memories.fact: 67 schemas (45 custom), 11742 rules (307 custom), 1641 wage types, 2888 features (19 custom)
memories.implication: the payroll engine is configuration and reads like data. Run this before assuming any staff-cost calculation is unreachable

memories.subject: change governance
memories.fact: 9 channel differences, 20 objects changed in production and never transported
memories.implication: the maintainer population is the norm. Run this before asking anyone for a policy — and read every finding with its counter-explanation

memories.subject: MULESOFT
memories.fact: MULESOFT creates 85% of new WBS elements since 2024, up from 0% through 2022. The project master is written by an interface, not by people
memories.implication: when a master table's custom fields change behaviour, check WHO CREATES the rows before theorising about policy. A field's fill rate is a property of whoever writes it, and here the writer changed

memories.subject: _an_interface_converges_the_grammar
memories.fact: YYE_BENEF1 held mixed identifier shapes while humans filled it and converged to 100% DDDDDDDD once MULESOFT took over WBS creation in 2024
memories.implication: grammar convergence DATES an automation. When a field's shape distribution collapses to one form, look for the interface that took over — and the variance before it is the measure of what the hand cost

memories.subject: PRPS.YYE_POC
memories.fact: a flag holding 'X' on 367 project ROOTS that marks arrival through the new Core Planner path. What it really selects is COMPLETENESS: the flagged rows carry the whole classification block including a properly-named donor
memories.implication: when a flag has one value, it is a PERIMETER. Find what its population has that the rest does not, and the flag names itself — here, the population where the project master can be trusted

memories.subject: _what_the_interface_did_not_absorb
memories.fact: across the Core Manager handover YYE_PRCRT stayed at 49% and YYE_RELEV at 40% while every other structural field jumped. The fields that did NOT move are the ones the interface does not write
memories.implication: after an automation, the fields whose fill rate is UNCHANGED identify exactly what the interface did not absorb — and therefore what still depends on human practice. That is a cheaper scope map than reading the interface spec

memories.subject: restos sin clasificar
memories.fact: el cubo UNKNOWN es un SENSOR, no un residuo. Sus 44 nombres en la primera corrida de A19 delataban una gramatica entera que el autor no conocia: queries GUARDADAS CON NOMBRE, cuyo nombre dice el objetivo (PA_IT0008 salario base, VENDOR_BANK).
memories.implication: nunca pliegues el resto dentro de la clase mayoritaria para que cuadre. Leelo: es la unica parte del dato que te dice lo que no sabias que buscar

memories.subject: rsau / SM20
memories.fact: la retencion real en P01 es >= 182 dias medidos, no los ~14 que asumia el acumulador. El techo de 70 que se fijo antes no era del sistema: era el dia mas profundo que habia probado la sonda.
memories.implication: cuando midas un limite, di si es del SISTEMA o de tu INSTRUMENTO. Un techo sacado de la propia sonda redefine 'irrecuperable' como 'mas atras de donde mire', y lo hace en silencio

memories.subject: cdhdr_history por clase
memories.fact: el volumen esta brutalmente concentrado: FMRESERV 52% y PBC 36% son el 88% de los 13,97M de cambios, y ninguna de las dos alcanza documento. Las 6 clases que SI combinan cubren el 8,8%.
memories.implication: no publiques una cobertura de casos sin decir DONDE esta el resto. Y no pidas una extraccion antes de saber por que no casa: FMRESERV falla porque sus documentos son del rango 32* y fmbl solo tiene 1x/2x/4x -- otro tipo de documento, no una tabla ausente

memories.subject: FMRESERV + PBC
memories.fact: no son dos clases sueltas: son el motor de compromiso presupuestario de la plantilla. FMRESERV se cambia desde PA30 (425.956), ZPBC_PERIOD_CLS_EXEC (286.704) y HRPBC_ENGINE_PNP (156.581), y 5.980.533 de sus cambios (82%) no llevan transaccion ninguna.
memories.implication: el mayor flujo de cambios del sistema no se teclea, se genera. Cualquier analisis de 'quien cambia el presupuesto' que mire transacciones de dialogo ve el 18% y cree que lo ve todo
